item.title: Dead foxes, 5th October
item.description:
In the past week ive seen atleast 5 dead foxes, and in the past month theres been double that with 2 even ending up outside of my house. Im worried if theres either a bigger predator that could potentially harm people in this area OR if theres foul play involved. If i see over 5 more this week i think it should be investigated because it could also be a disease of some sort as none of them were road kill or looked dismantled.

item.title: Constant dog poo left behind by same owner on grass here, 5th October
item.description:
Every single day on this patch of grass there are at least 15 different mounds of dog poo, some fresh some very old and it’s extremely clear that it’s the same person doing it every time. It’s absolutely disgusting and in a very high footfall area, I myself have stepped in it twice and have heard from others that they have also. Leaving dog waste is illegal in England and this area is simply unwalkable. It has been this way for months. Please can you firstly, remove the existing waste, but furthermore please please put up specific signs (multiple) at this location reminding them of its illegality and how awful it is. Furthermore, it would be helpful if there was another bin here. However, the last part is not as necessary but it provides no excuses. I’ve waited a while to see if the behaviour will change but it has not and it’s just completely inconsiderate and disgusting! I think signs would really help, in particular ones that state that it is known to happen here and the council is aware / reminders of fines.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Great Guildford Street, Southwark, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
